name: Character Image
summary: Prompt pack and identity-lock review contract for reusable character image generation.

license_policy.notes: Character identity prompts must avoid unlicensed real-person likeness unless explicitly authorized.

prompt_pack.system: Generate an original game-ready animated character with a stable silhouette, consistent outfit, clear face shape, and repeatable color palette.
prompt_pack.negative: Avoid celebrity likeness, logos, text, watermarks, extra limbs, inconsistent outfit details, and unstable proportions.
